Question: Right now I am working in Iraq for US soldiers, it is a Catering company. Which is cooking & serving food for US Army and dealing with all kind of foods including pork. My job is in the warehouse. So my question is, the money which I am earning is it Halaal? Second I have to support my entire family member. Whatever I m earning, all I send to them. And intention of my earning is not for me but for them and others. Is my money will be Halal or Haram? Kindly explain me in details. Answer ID: 672 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 540=530/B) Keeping pork in warehouse, protecting it and handling it is helping in sin. Your earning is not purely Halal. You should look for any Halal job in any other company and repent to Allah for this wrongdoing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
